title.zh: 【汇丰、摩根大通等五家银行成立 GL1 Org，以推动代币化金融市场标准建设】
title.en: 【汇丰、摩根大通等五家银行成立 GL1 Org，以推动代币化金融市场标准建设】

current_state.zh: Five global banks — HSBC, JPMorgan's Kinexys, MUFG, Societe Generale-Forge and Standard Chartered — established the Singapore-based non-profit GL1 Org to develop shared standards and frameworks for tokenized financial markets and cross-border regulated tokenized asset deployment.
current_state.en: Five global banks — HSBC, JPMorgan's Kinexys, MUFG, Societe Generale-Forge and Standard Chartered — established the Singapore-based non-profit GL1 Org to develop shared standards and frameworks for tokenized financial markets and cross-border regulated tokenized asset deployment.
